questions.q: Where did Guru Nanak Dev Ji settle during the final years of his life?
questions.qPa: ਗੁਰੂ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੇਵ ਜੀ ਨੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਜੀਵਨ ਦੇ ਆਖਰੀ ਸਾਲ ਕਿੱਥੇ ਬਿਤਾਏ?
questions.explanation: Guru Nanak Dev Ji settled in Kartarpur (now in Pakistan) on the banks of the river Ravi after his Udasis.

questions.q: Which Guru is credited with standardizing the Gurmukhi script?
questions.qPa: ਗੁਰਮੁਖੀ ਲਿਪੀ ਨੂੰ ਮਿਆਰੀ ਬਣਾਉਣ ਦਾ ਸਿਹਰਾ ਕਿਸ ਗੁਰੂ ਨੂੰ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ?
questions.explanation: Guru Angad Dev Ji standardized the Gurmukhi script to make religious texts accessible to the common people.

questions.q: The Manji system was established by which Guru to effectively preach Sikhism?
questions.explanation: Guru Amar Das Ji established the Manji system (22 dioceses) to manage the growing Sikh community.

questions.q: Match the Guru with the city founded: Guru Ram Das Ji.
questions.explanation: Guru Ram Das Ji founded the city of Ramdaspur, which later became known as Amritsar.

questions.q: What was the primary purpose of the Masand system?
options: To collect funds (Dasvandh) for community projects
questions.explanation: Introduced by Guru Ram Das Ji, the Masand system's purpose was to collect offerings and funds from distant congregations for construction work.

questions.q: In which year was the compilation of the Adi Granth completed?
questions.qPa: ਆਦਿ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਦੀ ਸੰਪਾਦਨਾ ਕਿਸ ਸਾਲ ਪੂਰੀ ਹੋਈ?
questions.explanation: Guru Arjan Dev Ji completed the compilation of the Adi Granth in the year 1604.

questions.q: Who laid the foundation stone of Harmandir Sahib?
questions.explanation: The Sufi saint Mian Mir laid the foundation stone of Harmandir Sahib at the request of Guru Arjan Dev Ji.

questions.q: Who constructed the Baoli (stepwell) with 84 steps at Goindwal Sahib?
questions.explanation: Guru Amar Das Ji constructed the Baoli at Goindwal Sahib.
